name: Modal
title: Modal
summary: A white dialog over a dimmed scrim that holds one short task or one decision, including the confirmation dialog for destructive and neutral choices.
whenToUse: Use a dialog (S or M) for a short focused task that should not leave the page: send an app link, request NFC Bible cards.
Use the confirmation dialog before an action that cannot be undone or loses work: remove a partner, leave an unfinished sign-up.
whenNotToUse: Do not use a modal for long forms, reading content or anything with more than one step; give it its own page.
Do not open a modal on page load or on scroll. Open it only from a click.
Do not confirm actions that can be undone; do them and offer Undo in a Toast.

anatomy.description: Scrim, panel, header (title + 44px close X), body, footer with a secondary button then one primary.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the dialog asks to open or close (Esc, X, scrim click, or a closing button).

props.name: title
props.description: The title: the task or the question. Labels the dialog (`aria-labelledby`).

props.name: variant
props.description:
`dialog` is a short task with a close X; `confirm` is a confirmation (`role="alertdialog"`, no X,
scrim clicks do nothing, Esc means Cancel).

props.name: size
props.description: Panel width: `s` is 400px, `m` is 560px.

props.name: tone
props.description: Confirm only: `danger` shows a red icon circle, `neutral` a blue one.

props.name: icon
props.description: Confirm only: icon inside the 48px circle. Defaults to a trash icon (danger) or an info icon (neutral).

props.name: description
props.description: Confirm only: the one-sentence consequence, linked with `aria-describedby`.

props.name: children
props.description: Body content (dialog variant).

props.name: footer
props.description: Footer buttons: secondary first, then one primary. Build them with `Button` (`size="sm"`).

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the close X.

props.name: closeOnScrim
props.description: Close when the scrim is clicked. Ignored by `confirm`.

props.name: initialFocusRef
props.description:
Element to focus when the dialog opens. Defaults to the first element with `data-autofocus`,
else the Cancel (first footer) button in a confirmation, else the first form field, else the title.

props.name: scrimClassName
props.description: Class names for the scrim wrapper.

props.name: visible
props.description: Whether the dialog is shown. Open it only from a tap, never on load or scroll.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called by the close button, a scrim tap (when allowed) and the hardware back button / Esc.

props.name: title
props.description: Task or question: "Get the dot.Bible app". Also the accessible name of the dialog.

props.name: children
props.description: Body content, 16dp, one or two sentences or a short form.

props.name: footer
props.description: Footer: a secondary button, then one primary. Right-aligned.

props.name: size
props.description: Max width 400 (`s`) or 560 (`m`).

props.name: dismissOnScrim
props.description: Closing by tapping the scrim.

props.name: showClose
props.description: Show the 44dp close button.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the close button.

variants.notes: max-width 400px; a sentence and two buttons
max-width 560px; a short form (.fb-modal-grid for two fields side by side)
the primary keeps the reader safe ("Keep editing")

variantNotes: `.fb-scrim` is the fixed full-screen overlay. `.fb-scrim-demo` is an in-page stage for docs and previews only.

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Title 20px/600. Body 16px, `--gray-700`. Footer has a 1px `--gray-200` rule and right-aligned buttons, `.btn-sm`.
Footer order: secondary first, then one primary. One Horizon Blue primary per dialog.
Destructive actions use `.fb-danger` (`--error` fill) and name the action ("Remove partner"), never "OK" or "Yes".
The close X is `.fb-x`, a 44px round button, top right. Confirmation dialogs have no X: the two buttons are the only way out.
Esc, the X or a scrim click closes a dialog. In a confirmation, Esc means Cancel and scrim clicks do nothing.
On phones the panel keeps 16px from the screen edges and scrolls inside itself (`max-height: calc(100vh - 32px)`).
Lock page scroll while open. One modal at a time; never open a modal from a modal.

accessibility: `role="dialog"` (or `role="alertdialog"` for confirmations), `aria-modal="true"`, `aria-labelledby` the title; confirmations also `aria-describedby` the sentence.
On open, move focus into the dialog: the first field in a form, the Cancel button in a confirmation, otherwise the title (`tabindex="-1"`).
Trap Tab inside the dialog. On close, return focus to the button that opened it.
Focus ring on every control: `outline: 2px solid var(--horizon-blue); outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-focus)`.
Icons in the dialog are `aria-hidden="true"`; the close button has `aria-label="Close"`.
content: Title is the task or the question. "Get the dot.Bible app", "Remove this partner?", "Leave without saving?"
The body says what will happen, in one or two sentences. "Grace Fellowship will lose access to the partner dashboard. You can invite them again later."
Button labels are verbs that match the title: "Send link", "Send request", "Remove partner", "Keep editing". Dismiss with "Not now" or "Cancel".
Never use "Are you sure?" as the whole message.
